$comment: The versions every fwd-stack project is held to. The baseline workflow (.github/workflows/baseline.yml) compares a project's package.json files, Node pin and packageManager against these. Raise a pin here first, then in each project.
nodeMinimumReason: Node's October 2026 security release: TLS hostname-check bypass, Brotli decompression RCE, and distrust of the compromised eMudhra intermediates. Each project raises its Node pin to at least this.
